desc: Parse input and build the graph using adjacency lists.
BFS/DFS from unvisited vertices to compute the bipartition color and component sizes `a` and `b`.
For each component, compute `moves = a*(a-1)//2 + b*(b-1)//2 - existing_edges_in_component`.
XOR all `moves` values; if non-zero, print "Aoki", else "Takahashi".
